title: Which Country Matches Your Personality?
summary: Explore First Impressions, Your Everyday Rhythm, Comfort and Curiosity, People and Celebrations, Your Ideal Escape across five six-question rounds.

landing.intro:
Follow what feels like you.
Discover your country-inspired match.

about.body:
Five rounds offer different angles on this challenge: First Impressions, Your Everyday Rhythm, Comfort and Curiosity, People and Celebrations, Your Ideal Escape. Each round contains six distinct questions.

Choose one of four answers and move on automatically. There is no time limit. A short rewarded ad opens the quiz, each next round and the final result. There are no right or wrong answers. Your choices contribute to the same four playful country-inspired profiles.

For entertainment and self-reflection only. This quiz does not determine nationality, identity or where anyone should live.

steps: Press Start, watch a short rewarded ad and begin.
Choose one answer per question and progress through five rounds.
Complete all 30 questions to reveal your result. You can then unlock the full breakdown.

profile-1.title: You Match Italy
profile-1.copy: Warmth, expression and the pleasure of shared moments run through your choices. You value beauty and tradition, but you also know that life is better when there is time for conversation, food and the people who matter.

profile-2.title: You Match Japan
profile-2.copy: Your answers favour care, meaning and attention to detail. You are drawn to experiences that combine tradition with fresh thinking, and you appreciate calm spaces where small rituals can make an ordinary day feel intentional.

profile-3.title: You Match Australia
profile-3.copy: Open space, easy conversation and a willingness to try something new shape your result. You prefer life with room to move, people who do not take themselves too seriously and plans that can become adventures.

profile-4.title: You Match Sweden
profile-4.copy: Balance, simplicity and quiet quality stand out across your choices. You value personal space without losing connection, and you are happiest when comfort, nature and thoughtful design work together.
